# agentic-mentions

Collect and triage brand mentions and inbound comments.

Keywords: mentions,listening,triage,agentic-suite,cli,mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-mentions".
- CLI: agentic-mentions summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-mentions mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs
